svg.text: Trial 2 — prompt engineering: does the prompt change the decision?
Same agent, same data, same parser. Each rung adds exactly one element to the rung below it.
P3 and P4 are the shipped prompts verbatim (analyst_eval_v2 / v3). P0–P2 were built by subtraction from v2.
Unparseable responses are excluded from accuracy AND from false-deploy — a rung that answers nothing is not "safe".
Axis domains are shared between arms within a panel, so the two models are directly comparable.
Verdict accuracy on the 3 graded cases
False-deploy rate (deployed a strategy that should be rejected)
Cases where every repeat gave the same verdict (of 4)
Prompt size in tokens (what the instructions cost)
Dots are labelled with their rung number. Where two rungs scored the same, the dots are fanned vertically off a shared point.
